title: Wire MiniMax H3 as a model (blocked on the licence gate)
description: Ship MiniMax H3 in Cubric Vision: engine bump off the 0.29.2 pin to 0.30.x, workflow template/runtime split, dependencies.js entries pointed at the publisher's own repo (NEVER re-hosted on R2), models.js ModelDef, progressStages, type-consumer sweep. H3 emits video AND native stereo audio from one sampler pass, so the LTX audio I/O in docs/models/ltx/audio-input.md is the prior art for surfacing sound. BLOCKED: the licence authorization is conditioned on a user flow-down commitment that does not exist yet - MPI-451 must land first. Feasibility numbers and the weight matrix live on MPI-449.
acceptance: MPI-451 has landed and H3 carries a licence descriptor - this card cannot start before that
Engine bumped off 0.29.2 with the custom-node pairing check run first, per .claude/rules/comfy_engine.md
H3 weights download from the publisher's own repository - nothing re-hosted on R2
A working op produces video AND its audio track in the app, not just on the bench
The licence text ships and is reachable in-app, with the required NOTICE string and attribution
Written confirmation on whether the authorization extends to end users in excluded territories, or the gate carries the user's own authorization route
